THE DEFINITION

Bicep template

Describes the storage resources in code. Parameters make the region, account name, container name and storage SKU configurable.

targetScope = 'resourceGroup'
param storageAccountName string
param containerName string = 'data'

One definition, configurable deployments.

01 / CONTEXT

The idea.

A focused infrastructure-as-code project defining an Azure Storage Account, Blob Service and private Blob Container through a reusable Bicep template.

02 / ENGINEERING

The design problem.

Representing resource dependencies and deployment configuration in a repeatable definition.

Parameters control the region, storage name, container and SKU. Parent-child resource declarations express dependencies, while outputs expose the deployed resource identifiers. The documented workflow includes validation and What-If analysis.

03 / IMPLEMENTATION

Inside the project.

  • Parameterized storage configuration
  • Storage Account → Blob Service → Container hierarchy
  • Container with public access disabled
  • Deployment outputs for resource names and identifiers

A cloud learning project focused on Azure storage provisioning. Deployment steps and outcomes are documented in the repository; no production scale or uptime claims are made.
